## Trigger

<!-- Which recognised trigger? See governance §5. -->

- [ ] Implementation learning — building it showed the design does not hold
- [ ] Assumption invalidated
- [ ] Constraint change
- [ ] Requirement discovered in a later phase
- [ ] Principle conflict in a case not previously encountered

## The problem

<!-- What specifically does not hold? Be concrete: which artefact, which claim, what contradicts it. -->

## Evidence

<!-- What demonstrates the problem? A failing test, a measurement, a dependency that does not behave as assumed. -->

## Affected artefacts

<!-- Which documents, requirements, ADRs, components and assumptions are in scope? -->

## Proposed direction

<!-- Optional. The ADR carries the real options analysis; this is a starting position. -->

## Assessment

- [ ] Needs an ADR
- [ ] Affects scope or a principle (charter/scope/principles amendment required)
- [ ] Affects requirements or traceability
- [ ] Blocks current implementation work
